<document id="support-deceased">
IfˆanˆaccountˆholderˆhasˆdiedˆWe'reˆsorryˆforˆyourˆloss.ˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆletˆusˆknowˆthatˆaˆTallowbrookˆmemberˆhasˆdied.ˆ##ˆTellˆusˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆBereavement,ˆorˆmessageˆsupport.ˆSupportˆpassesˆeveryˆbereavementˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆitˆfromˆstartˆtoˆfinish.ˆ##ˆWhatˆAccountˆServicesˆwillˆaskˆforˆ-ˆTheˆdeathˆcertificateˆ-ˆProofˆthatˆyou'reˆtheˆexecutorˆorˆadministratorˆofˆtheˆestate,ˆorˆtheˆnextˆofˆkinˆ-ˆYourˆphotoˆIDˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆOnceˆwe'reˆnotified,ˆweˆfreezeˆtheˆaccountˆandˆcardsˆtoˆprotectˆthem.ˆRecurringˆpaymentsˆstop.ˆDirectˆdepositsˆreceivedˆafterˆtheˆdateˆofˆdeathˆmayˆbeˆreturnedˆtoˆtheˆsender.ˆAfterˆAccountˆServicesˆconfirmsˆwho'sˆauthorized,ˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆpaidˆtoˆtheˆestate.ˆ##ˆTimingˆAccountˆServicesˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆPleaseˆdon'tˆtryˆtoˆsignˆinˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆorˆuseˆitsˆcards.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-power-of-attorney">
PowerˆofˆattorneyˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆforˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember,ˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteamˆcanˆaddˆyouˆtoˆtheirˆaccountˆasˆanˆagent.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆneedˆ-ˆAˆcopyˆofˆtheˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆdocument,ˆsignedˆandˆinˆeffectˆ-ˆYourˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆYourˆcontactˆdetailsˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆitˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆPowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆaskˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆtoˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheirˆsession.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreviewˆtheˆdocuments.ˆTheyˆgoˆtoˆAccountˆServices.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆconfirmˆwhatˆtheyˆreceived,ˆandˆmayˆaskˆforˆmoreˆinformation.ˆ##ˆUntilˆit'sˆapprovedˆWeˆcan'tˆshareˆinformationˆorˆtakeˆinstructionsˆfromˆyouˆuntilˆAccountˆServicesˆhasˆapprovedˆtheˆdocument.ˆThatˆincludesˆfreezingˆcardsˆorˆchangingˆplans.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆbeingˆexploitedˆfinancially,ˆtellˆus.ˆWeˆtreatˆthatˆasˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="savings-apy-basic-v2">
SavingsˆrateˆonˆBasicˆOnˆtheˆBasicˆplan,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆearnˆ0.50%ˆAPY,ˆeffectiveˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆ-ˆTheˆrateˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ-ˆInterestˆcompoundsˆdailyˆandˆisˆpaidˆmonthly.ˆ-ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆpocketˆtoˆearnˆit.ˆ-ˆThere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆlimitˆonˆwithdrawals.ˆ##ˆRatesˆareˆvariableˆWeˆmayˆchangeˆtheˆrate.ˆWe'llˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆaˆdecrease.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆstartˆearningˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆinˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆinˆandˆoutˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree.ˆInterestˆforˆeachˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆtheˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplansˆYourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆUpgradesˆtakeˆeffectˆrightˆawayˆandˆdowngradesˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆ##ˆEarnˆmoreˆPlusˆmembersˆearnˆ2.00%ˆAPYˆonˆtheˆsameˆbalance.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
